props.gloss_en: with a kavul and with a foreign wig, to the courtyard
Rav: whatever the Sages forbade going out with into the public domain, one may not go out with into the courtyard
Rav: except the kavul and the foreign wig
R' Anani bar Sason in R' Yishmael's name: everything is like the kavul [and may be worn into the courtyard]
[the stam: and Rav -- what is different about these?] Ulla: so that she not become repulsive to her husband
the early elders said: [a niddah] shall not paint her eyes, nor rouge, nor adorn herself in coloured garments
R' Akiva: if so, you make her repulsive to her husband, and her husband will come to divorce her
R' Akiva: rather, what does 'and of her who is unwell in her niddah' teach? in her niddah she remains until she comes into the water
Rav: wherever the Sages forbade because of marit ha'ayin, it is forbidden even in the innermost chambers
the mishna (cited with תנן at 64b.17): nor [does a donkey go out] with a bell, even though it is plugged
another baraita: he may plug a bell on its neck and walk with it in the courtyard
it is a dispute of tannaim [whether a marit-ha'ayin prohibition holds even out of view]
the first tanna: he spreads them in the sun [where the people do not see]
the first tanna: but not opposite the people
R' Eliezer and R' Shimon forbid [spreading them even where the people do not see]

supports.gloss_en: כדתניא: ... עד שבא רבי עקיבא ולימד: אם כן אתה מגנה על בעלה -- the concern that she not become repulsive to her husband is R' Akiva's
דתניא: שוטחן בחמה אבל לא כנגד העם, רבי אליעזר ורבי שמעון אוסרין -- the tannaim dispute whether it is forbidden even out of the people's view

objections.gloss_en: תנן: בכבול ובפאה נכרית לחצר. בשלמא לרב ניחא, אלא לרבי ענני בר ששון קשיא! -- the mishna names only the kavul and the wig for the courtyard: that fits Rav, but is difficult for R' Anani

answered_by.gloss_en: רבי ענני בר ששון משמיה דמאן קאמר ליה? משמיה דרבי ישמעאל בר יוסי, ורבי ישמעאל בר יוסי תנא הוא ופליג -- he speaks for a tanna, who may dispute the mishna

objections.gloss_en: עד שבא רבי עקיבא ולימד: אם כן אתה מגנה על בעלה ונמצא בעלה מגרשה -- the elders' ban would make her repulsive to her husband and lead him to divorce her

תנן: ולא בזוג אף על פי שפקוק; ותניא אידך: פוקק לה זוג בצוארה ומטייל עמה בחצר -- what the mishna forbids going out with, the baraita permits in the courtyard (the mishna is p_chamor_zug_pakuk; see header)

answered_by.gloss_en: תנאי היא -- it is a dispute of tannaim (= p_marit_ayin_tannaei_hi)
